status: candidate-capable; native dispatch requires committed-and-pushed source gate
provider: current Codex chat model; not isolated API provider

finalize.handle: paid feasible improvement or null baseline

update_semantics.xgboost_regression: Fit once on the frozen family-filtered historical cohort; no target-label refit.
update_semantics.xgboost_pairwise_ranker: Fit once on the frozen family-filtered historical cohort; rank_score is not speedup or confidence.
update_semantics.xgboost_normalized: Fit once on the frozen family-filtered historical cohort; output is normalized saved-cycle-per-occurrence, not speedup.
update_semantics.feasible_benefit_xgb: Fit once; utility and ensemble spread are not measured speedup or calibrated uncertainty.
update_semantics.factorized_feasibility_xgb: Fit once; bootstrap feasibility scores are uncalibrated disagreement.
update_semantics.hybrid_gp_zero_shot: Use the frozen initial hardware-posterior predictions throughout.
update_semantics.hybrid_gp_adapt: Refit the existing hardware surrogate on historical rows plus this policy's own verified successful paid prefix; failures do not enter the numeric fit.
update_semantics.codex_chat_llm_agent: No model refit; the current chat model receives public data, model predictions, constraints, and only outcomes returned by its own paid actions.
update_semantics.fixed_joint_posterior: Not in the frozen Ascon policy set; separate fixed-initial Gaussian conditioning contract, not equivalent to hybrid_gp_adapt refitting.

paid_update_rule: Reserve before evaluator dispatch. Only successful, correctness-verified outcomes enter numeric updates. Known failures consume a query but are not labels. Unknown/interrupted outcomes stop the session and are never retried.
uncertainty: All XGBoost ensemble/bootstrap spread and GP intervals are uncalibrated unless separately calibrated; ranking score is not speedup.
comparison: The frozen controls use the same seed-0 model artifacts, candidate features, area/timing limits, and at most three logical queries. Full-pool oracle replay occurs only after the LLM decision trace is sealed and every reference attempt resolves.
costs: Keep candidate evaluation wall/native command time, fixed model fit/inference time, adaptive GP refit time, and LLM request-to-action wall time separate. The current chat does not expose model-only latency or tokens.
